notes.title: Controller Support Update!
notes.notes:
Changes:

Turned off slow-motion effect by default (Can be turned back on from Gameplay settings)
Changed description of some passive items & tooltips for better clarity
You can no longer get the same item more than once in the shop 
Made "Gunner" minion stop at a closer distance
Nerfed "Gunner" boss by making his shooting pattern randomized
The "Air Blaster" & "Air Striker" bosses and minions now predict your movement and aim their projectiles at your anticipated destination
Nerfed "Echo Heal" item
Nerfed "Shield"
Reduced deceleration when using the handbrake and increased slipperiness to make initiating drifts smoother and more dynamic


Additions:

Added full controller support (Any gamepad model should be compatible), just ensure to plug your controller prior to launching the game!
Added a separate tutorial for gamepad controls
Added photo-mode camera rotation sensitivity option (for Gamepad only) in Gameplay settings
Added "Automatic Rotation Option" tutorial (for Keyboard only)
Added patrol enemies that spawn when you're away from enemy zones



Bugs:

Fixed bug where sometimes "gravity inverser" won't deal fall damage to affected enemies
Fixed bug where sometimes your car resets position inside the spawn door
Fixed HUD bugs with "1440x900" resolution
Fixed bug where blueprints would sometimes overlap
Fixed bug where sometimes you find more than 2 upgrades in one level
Fixed bug where bosses don't reset position when stuck on a wall



Your feedback is invaluable in helping us improve Riot Ride!
Thank you for your ongoing bug reports and suggestions — keep them coming! We're committed to delivering regular, high-quality updates to enhance your experience, so stay tuned for more improvements soon!

notes.title: Quality Of Life Update
notes.notes:

Fixed a typo in the "Oil Dropper" tooltip
Corrected the "Flying Kit" tooltip
In "Garage" there's now a "Back" button to go return from menus
New upgrade panels will now show you the type of the received upgrade
The "Shield" will now be destroyed after absorbing 100 damage and will remain active for 5 seconds
Nerfed "EMP Charger" damage rate
Made "Oil Splash" bigger
Added "+" sign near "0%" stats in stats menus
Added passive item names to tooltips
Car paints & liveries will no longer be lost upon losing a run
Enemies will no longer spawn continuously on your car
Made "Hard Mode" a bit easier
The "Air Blaster" boss will no longer shoot at you until your car's rotation has fully recovered
Nerfed "Gunner" boss bullet speed and bullet separation length


Additions:

Added a flash animation to the "Full passive items inventory" warning in the shop to make it clearer


Bugs:

Main menu button not working in the pre-boss-level confirmation panel
Fixed bugs regarding the new Garage tutorials
Fixed a bug where activating the "Shield" prevented exiting the level
Fixed bug where bosses' damage circles won't despawn after their death
Fixed a bug where the "Homing Hunter" enemy would sometimes target walls instead of the player
Fixed bug where sometimes if you refund a passive item in the shop, the starting tutorial pops up

notes.title: Release Update
notes.notes:
Changes:

Made the car more maneuverable when it gets stuck in walls (especially ramps)
Made ramps connected
Nerfed "Homing Hunter" enemy
Nerfed "Gunner" enemy
Changed default keybinds of actives  & side upgrades to "A" & "E, respectively"
Landmines now one-shot all enemies regardless of their health (excluding bosses)
Increased the hitbox scale of landmines


Additions:

Added new achievements to unlock
Settings will now make sounds when interacted with
Added a "healing cube" in each level, which you'll find on the elevated surfaces


Bugs:

Fixed bug where sometimes your game save resets after reopening the game later
Fixed bug where "Laser Gunners" & "EMP chargers" shoot from behind walls
Fixed bug where the game would detect a player in air while they're on the ground
Fixed bug where refund buttons in the shop menu sometimes become non-intractable

Added tooltips next to recovered upgrades in the shop menu
Added a "Back" button to the "passive items inventory" in "Garage"
Added a video tutorial on 'shooting,' as it's slightly different from other top-down games (bullets hit exactly where you aim)


Bugs:

Fixed bug where passive items' effects still occur even after starting a new run

notes.title: Quality of life update
notes.notes:
This one brings many fixes, gameplay enhancements and game balancing features

Changes:

Removed menus "beating-to-music" effect
Decreased difficulty curve
Nerfed enemy "Gunner" (both normal & boss)
Nerfed boss "Bomber" (He's now unable to throw bombs when you're stuck beneath him)
Set the camera behind the player by default
Buildings will now have complementary colors to the ground for better visibility and contrast
Nerfed "Missile Launcher" upgrade explosion force and camera shake caused from its explosion
Nerfed upgrade stat penalties that get applied upon equipping them
Changed "Bomb Trigger" upgrade to a shockwave that instantly blows any "Bomber" enemy it hits (Ineffective against boss "Bomber")


Additions:

Added bounciness to the boss arena's walls
Bosses will now teleport away if the player is stuck beneath them
Upon starting a new boss fight, your health will be fully recovered
You will now get a warning before starting a level with a boss fight


Bugs:

Fixed bug where sometimes you couldn't resume your game after pausing
Fixed bug where the "upgrade" tutorial doesn't finish
Fixed bug where shockwave effects were being applied after a delay


Your feedback is invaluable in helping us improve Riot Ride!
Thank you for your ongoing bug reports and suggestions — keep them coming! We're committed to delivering regular, high-quality updates to enhance your experience, so stay tuned for more improvements soon!
